dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: I can't cope...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: Hmm? Who goes there? All who wish to cross this bridge are subject to interrogation, those are the rules.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: That said... Just look at what you're wearing! You're definitely not someone I need to worry about...

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: Why? Think about it — criminals would want to dress as discreetly as possible, no? You, on the other hand, are dressed most ostentatiously indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: I am the Millelith responsible for this zone. This is a major thoroughfare to Dihua Marsh. Merchants and tourists all pass this way, so I'm stationed here to stand guard.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: But this zone is much too big for one person. Just the other day, I discovered a group of monsters nearby...

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: It appears they've set up a camp, and although they haven't made a move yet it's definitely a safety risk. I need to keep an eye on them.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: I'd happily go and clear them out — except, I worry that if I left my post here, some other monsters would seize the chance to ambush passers-by. I feel so helpless, stuck here all day...

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: Can you go and sort out the monsters over there for me? It would free me up to concentrate on other matters...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: You have my thanks. I'll stay here and keep watch to stop anyone from taking a wrong turn and ending up deep in Dihua Marsh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I'm busy.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: Oh? No big deal, I'll work something out. With any luck, the higher-ups will send me some backup within the next few days...

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: Normally, everyone who wishes to cross this bridge is subject to interrogation.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: But given your exotic attire, you don't strike me as a suspicious character. I'll let you off.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Exotic attire?

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: Yes. You're dressed very ostentatiously indeed... So you're definitely not someone to worry about.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: Think about it. Criminals would want to dress as discreetly as possible, no?

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: That's based on my experience guarding this bridge, in any case.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your work.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: As long as this bridge is here, someone needs to guard it! We can't afford to let our guard down, not for one second.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: The bridge is a major thoroughfare. So to be handed the job of guarding it is the highest recognition I could ask for.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: I will never let our enemies have their way, even if it costs me my life!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: Alright, off you go. Tread gently on the bridge, now. Don't step on anything.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: Normally, everyone who wishes to cross this bridge is subject to interrogation.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: I spy a traveler in exotic attire... What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Still only you stationed here?

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: Yeah, the higher-ups said there's no one else they could free up...

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: But never mind. As long as this bridge stands, I'll be here guarding it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you seen someone who looks a lot like me?

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: Does the person you want to find dress as... uniquely as you?

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: In that case, I've never seen anyone like that. But if they do, that should definitely leave an impression.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: I remember everyone who crosses this bridge, never mind someone with such an unusual appearance.

dialogues.speaker: Qiaoxi
dialogues.text: I'll keep a look out on your behalf. While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail.
